name: Citizenship by Residence (Naturalisation)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 14 years of legal residence in the Federation.
Applicants must first obtain a Certificate of Citizenship before becoming eligible for a passport; this process can take up to 6 months.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for and obtain the Certificate of Citizenship.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis -- Types of Citizenship: Citizenship by Residence requires 14 years of legal residence; Certificate of Citizenship required before passport eligibility, up to 6 months

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Kitts and Nevis' initial build. The 14-year residence requirement is notably the longest naturalisation period built anywhere this session -- more than double Aruba's/Curacao's/Sint Maarten's Kingdom-pattern 5 years and longer than Trinidad and Tobago's 12-month-plus-5-of-7-years formula. No good-character, language, or civics-knowledge sub-requirement was found on this source (unlike T&T's naturalisation route), which may reflect the source page's brevity rather than the absence of such conditions in the underlying Citizenship Act -- flagged as a possible gap rather than assumed not to exist.
